annual_fee_waiver_note: 官方 Key Facts Statement 列明 Annual Fee「Waived permanently」（基本卡同 additional card combined billing 都係），故 annual_fee 直接填 0。呢個豁免同 eligibility 門檻本身係分開嘅兩件事——冇資格做卓越理財就攞唔到呢張卡，唔關年費事。
card_name_zh: 滙豐卓越理財萬事達卡

provenance.evidence_excerpt: you earn $1 RewardCash for every HK$250 spent with your eligible card denominated in Hong Kong dollar. ... Every $1 RewardCash equals to HK$1 at RewardCash e-Shop. To qualify for HSBC Premier you need to maintain a Total Relationship Balance of HKD1,000,000 or more.

rewards.label: 基本回贈（全部合資格港元簽賬，唔限商戶/類別/貨幣——RewardCash Programme 通用 base rate，1 RewardCash = HK$1 固定，故直接記做 cash_rebate。呢張卡另有「Rewards of Your Choice」用戶可以自選一個類別攞 6X／2.4% 加成，因為要用戶自己揀，而家個 schema 表達唔到「用戶自選類別」，冇入。)
